1.in_words: Commencing at 10.4192°N 25.7118°E where SSD border meets Bahr al 'Arab the boundary runs east about 21 km along Bahr al 'Arab to 10.3919°N 25.8749°E then runs south-east along SSD border about 160 km to 9.4523°N 26.6359°E, crossing open bush about 10 km near Buta and a large pool surrounded by swampy ground before rejoining SSD border at 9.8016°N 26.3649°E. It then runs south-west about 23 km on a geological contact to 9.3638°N 26.4857°E and south about 24 km along 1930s District Boundary to K. Dabura at 9.1821°N 26.1323°E, then south about 36 km along K. Dabura to its junction with J. ABB – J. TELGONA – J. ABU KUKU ridge at 8.9444°N 26.1829°E. From there the line runs west about 49 km along K. Gama to tertiary road at 9.0006°N 25.5965°E, then runs about 100 km along tertiary road to J. TESI – J. ZANDI – J. TAGALLA ridge at 9.3594°N 25.4475°E, with a 7 km open bush crossing to J. OROKULLA – J. DELETI – J. KURNU BANDA ridge at 8.9418°N 25.4581°E. The boundary then runs north-west about 82 km along J. OROKULLA – J. DELETI – J. KURNU BANDA ridge to 9.2923°N 25.2927°E and continues south-west about 250 km across open ground and geological contacts, passing Umm Ragau and El Khadra, to SSD border at 10.3554°N 25.6031°E then north-east about 19 km along SSD border back to 10.4192°N 25.7118°E where SSD border meets Bahr al 'Arab.
